about: POST /api/open/v1/door/here, the heartbeat a visible lab page sends every 60 s (AGENT-DOOR A4 rev 2, 4.3). The page sends exactly {page, tab}; the Worker adds only the detector-qualified class and forwards nothing else about the visitor.

fields.tab: 32 lower-case hex (128 random bits held in page memory; not a cookie, not stored by the page)

responses.when: counted (a new tab) or refreshed (a known tab)
anything but exactly {page, tab} with an allowed page and a 32-hex tab
Sec-Fetch-Site present and not same-origin, or an Origin of another site
over the per-IP limit (in memory, at most 60 s) or the API's overall limit
presence is not measured on this deployment, or the API can't be reached

page_line: We count active tabs on each lab page. We keep a random tab id for up to a day to avoid double counting, and nothing else about you. Our hosting provider's network logs may record IP addresses.
